about: What EA's Pro Clubs API actually gives us, and how sure we are of each field. Only mark a field 'verified' after checking it against real data, and note the evidence.

thanks.thanks: Thank you for working these out and publishing them.

evidence.note: Player lines include both clubs. EA's API keeps only the last 10 matches per type, so everything older exists only in our database (matches.raw).

status.verified: Checked against real data; safe to build on.
status.assumed: Meaning follows from the name or a few examples, not proven.
status.unknown: Seen in the data, meaning not worked out.
status.useless: Always the same value, or contradicts other fields.

api.platform: every call needs ?platform=common-gen5 (current gen) or common-gen4
api.botFilter: EA rejects clients whose TLS fingerprint doesn't match a browser; scripts/fetch-ea.py uses curl_cffi with impersonate='chrome'
api.caching: EA's edge caches identical URLs for minutes; add a unique query param (e.g. _=timestamp)
notAvailable: matches older than the last 10 per match type
minute-by-minute events, goal times, xG, heatmaps
Rush, Live Tournament and Drop In matches (empty for this club)

timeAgo.meaning: {number, unit} relative to the request; not stored meaningfully

winnerByDnf.meaning: 1 = won because the other club quit

wins.meaning: 1 if this club won this match

TEAM.meaning: usually 99070108 for us, once 112; opponents vary

details.regionId.meaning: region as ASCII text in hex: 5719381 = 0x574555 = "WEU" (Western Europe); a trailing digit can mark a sub-region

details.teamId.meaning: probably the base team the club was created from

details.customKit.crestAssetId.meaning: crest image id, see lib/ea-assets.ts crestUrl

details.customKit.stadName.meaning: stadium name; default clubs show 'Tier 1 Stadium' in their language

details.customKit.kitColor1-4.meaning: home kit colours as RGB ints (body, trim, sleeve, extra)

details.customKit.kitId, customKitId, cu.meaning: kit design ids; no public image source

pos.meaning: broad group only: goalkeeper / defender / midfielder / forward

archetypeid.meaning: FC 27 archetype played, numbered in the game's order (keepers, defenders, midfielders, forwards)
archetypeid.evidence: in our 98 lines 1-2 only on keepers, 3-5 on defenders, 6-10 on midfielders, 11-13 on forwards; mo_nm (a 'target man') plays 13
archetypeid.confirmed: 2026-10-11 by the club: dirty8ightt Creator (midfield) and Magician (up front), mo_nm Target
archetypeid.usedFor: By archetype table on player pages

goals.meaning: EA's goals; on the line of whoever controls the CPU this INCLUDES the CPU teammates' goals

assists.meaning: as goals: includes CPU assists on the controller's line

shots.meaning: as goals: includes CPU shots on the controller's line

passesmade.meaning: includes CPU on the controller's line

passattempts.meaning: includes CPU on the controller's line

tacklesmade.meaning: includes CPU on the controller's line

tackleattempts.meaning: includes CPU on the controller's line

redcards.meaning: may include CPU cards on the controller's line

reflexSaves, parrySaves, punchSaves, bal.meaning: saves by type; they add up to less than saves (mo_nm 16 of 21), the rest are untyped

goalsconceded.meaning: goals conceded while this player was on the pitch

cleansheetsany, cleansheetsdef, cleanshe.meaning: EA's clean-sheet flags; always 0 so far, no full-length clean sheet saved yet to check against

secondsPlayed.meaning: in-game seconds on the pitch (90 min ≈ 5400)

realtimegame.meaning: real-world seconds in the match (~15-17 min for 90)
realtimegame.note: one outlier of 7052 s (EnEsC-37), maybe time in the lobby

realtimeidle.meaning: real-world seconds idle (AFK); max seen 9 s

wins, losses.meaning: mirror the club result for this player

match_event_aggregate_0..3.meaning: hidden per-player event counters, see matchEventCounters

*.meaning: the club's player lines summed (human lines only; CPU stats only via the controller's line)

skillRating.usedIn: matches.our_sr / opp_sr, saved when a match is first seen (games older than 3 h get none); /analysis opponent strength

lastMatch0-9.note: only 5 filled although more games were played; maybe resets with the season

lastOpponent0-9.meaning: club ids of recent opponents, 0 = newest
lastOpponent0-9.note: back-to-back games against the same club count once, so it does NOT line up with lastMatch

otherClubs.meaning: works for any club id, but only ONE id per call: several comma-separated ids return HTTP 400

currentDivision.meaning: says 5, but the in-game League Lobby showed Division 4 (4/9 pts, 3 chances) on 2026-10-11, matching our season tracker; don't use it for the current division

proName, proHeight, proNationality, proO.meaning: the pro's name, height cm, nation id, overall

proPos.meaning: position number, see lib/ea-assets.ts POSITIONS (5 = CB, 14 = CM, 25 = ST)

gamesPlayed, winRate, goals, assists, ra.meaning: season totals; include CPU stats for whoever controls the CPU

passesMade, passSuccessRate, tacklesMade.meaning: season totals and %; include CPU for the controller

cleanSheetsDef, cleanSheetsGK.meaning: 0 for everyone although the club has 3 clean sheets

prevGoals1-10.meaning: goals in each of the last 10 games, 1 = newest

prevGoals.meaning: goals in the latest game (same as prevGoals1?)

proPos, gamesPlayed, goals, assists, man.meaning: all-time totals for this club; fewer fields than members/stats

matchEventCounters.format: match_event_aggregate_0..3 hold 'id:count' pairs joined by commas; merge all four strings per player
matchEventCounters.keyFinding: The counters count the HUMAN's own actions. EA's headline goals/assists/shots add the CPU teammates' to the controller's line; the counters don't. So they give real per-player stats even for whoever plays ANY.

214.evidence: equals goals on 89/98 lines; all 9 mismatches are CPU-controller lines where the counter is lower

11.evidence: equals assists on 86/98 lines; all 12 mismatches are CPU-controller lines, counter lower

217.evidence: 217 + 218 equals shots on 85/98 lines; all 13 mismatches are CPU-controller lines, counter lower

derived.cpuGoals: club score minus the sum of counter 214 over the club's players (own goals by the opponent land here too); shown as “CPU” among the scorers on match pages and in Discord posts

267.evidence: equal on all 98 lines but only 3 non-zero

56.evidence: correlation 1.00 with saves, only 4 keeper lines

matchEventCounters.notYetDecoded: passes and tackles do not match any single counter or pair; likely split by type (e.g. 174, 175, 215, 216). Revisit with 30+ matches.
matchEventCounters.method: for each id compare per-line values with known stats (exact, correlation, pair sums) and check where mismatches fall
